# The Bukit Besi Tools

> 83 free online tools for code, SEO, writing, images and AI, plus Malaysian salary, zakat and BMI calculators. No signup needed.

This site hosts its own calculators and a directory of free tools, most of which run on https://www.thebukitbesi.com/. Tools on this site run in the browser and do not send inputs to this site. Last updated 2026-10-16.

## Tools and calculators on this site

- [AI Prompt Generator: Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Veo, Sora](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/ai-prompt-generator/): Builds AI image and video prompts from a subject plus style, lighting, framing, lens, mood, colour, camera movement and speed choices, and writes them in each platform's own format with three variations (as chosen, cinematic, artistic): Midjourney with --ar, --no and --stylize parameters; Stable Diffusion as comma keywords with a separate negative prompt and a CLIP token count (it reads about 75 tokens); ChatGPT/DALL·E and Flux as plain sentences without negative prompts; Google Veo and Sora with camera, dialogue and audio lines; Runway with the camera move first and no negative wording; Kling with its own negative prompt box. Includes a seeded 'Surprise me', shareable links, saved prompts kept in the browser, and a hand-off from the Image to Prompt tool.
- [ASB Dividend Calculator 2026: Yearly Payout, Projection & Loan](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/asb-dividend-calculator/): Calculates the Amanah Saham Bumiputera (ASB) income distribution (dividend plus bonus) from the average of each month's lowest balance, either from an opening balance and monthly saving or from twelve exact monthly lowest balances; projects the balance over up to 40 years with distributions reinvested and the RM200,000 input limit applied; and compares ASB financing instalments and interest with the distribution earned. Includes the ASB distribution history 2019–2025 (FY2025: 5.75 sen, 5.20 sen dividend + 0.55 sen bonus).
- [BMI Calculator Malaysia: Asian Cut-offs, Healthy Weight, Waist](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/bmi-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates adult body mass index (BMI) in metric or imperial units and classifies it with the Malaysian Clinical Practice Guidelines on Management of Obesity (Asian cut-offs: underweight below 18.5, healthy 18.5–22.9, overweight 23.0–27.4, obese class I 27.5–34.9, class II 35.0–39.9, class III 40 and above) alongside the WHO international categories; gives the healthy weight range for the height and the kilograms to lose or gain, and checks waist circumference (risk from 90 cm in men and 80 cm in women) and waist-to-height ratio (NICE: keep the waist below half the height).
- [Car Loan Calculator Malaysia 2026: Instalment, Road Tax, Insurance](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/car-loan-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates Malaysian car loan (hire purchase) instalments by the reducing-balance method with an effective interest rate (EIR), required by the Hire-Purchase (Amendment) Act from 1 June 2026 with a transition to 31 March 2027, or by the older flat-rate method; converts flat rate to EIR and back; shows total interest, a yearly schedule and the early settlement amount, including the Rule of 78 rebate for older flat-rate agreements; also estimates JPJ road tax by engine cc (Peninsular saloon or non-saloon, Sabah and Sarawak saloon) or by motor power for electric cars up to 310 kW and comprehensive insurance with NCD, 8% SST and stamp duty, and the total monthly cost of owning the car.
- [CGPA Calculator: SGPA to CGPA and GPA from Grades](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/cgpa-calculator/): Calculates CGPA from semester SGPAs (credit-weighted, or a simple average without credits) and GPA/CGPA from course letter grades on the UGC 10-point scale (O, A+, A … P, F) or the Malaysian 4.00 scale (A 4.00, A− 3.67, B+ 3.33 …), including continuing from a previous CGPA.
- [CGPA to Percentage Calculator: VTU, AKTU, SPPU, CBSE & More](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/cgpa-to-percentage/): Converts CGPA to percentage (and percentage back to CGPA) with the formula each university commonly publishes: CBSE CGPA × 9.5, VTU/AKTU/MAKAUT/SPPU (CGPA − 0.75) × 10, GTU (CGPA − 0.5) × 10, University of Mumbai CGPA × 7.1 + 11, Anna University CGPA × 10, any-scale proportional and custom formulas, with a full CGPA 5.0–10.0 conversion table.
- [City-Link Tracking: Track Your City-Link Express Parcel](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/citylink-tracking/): City-Link Express tracking: opens City-Link's official tracking page for a consignment number, explains the number format, common statuses, what to do when a delivery fails, and background on City-Link Express, founded in 1979 as Malaysia's first locally owned courier.
- [CSS Minifier: Minify & Compress CSS Online Free](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/css-minifier/): Minifies CSS in the browser: removes comments (keeps /*! licence comments), whitespace and last semicolons, shortens colours (#ffffff to #fff), numbers (0.50em to .5em) and zero lengths (0px to 0), and drops empty rules, without touching strings, url() values, custom properties or spaces inside calc(). Shows original, minified and gzip size; can also beautify (unminify) CSS. Tested against Bootstrap 5.3.3: 281,046 to 232,701 bytes with identical rendering. CSS is never uploaded.
- [Debt Consolidation Calculator Malaysia: Is It Worth It?](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/debt-consolidation-calculator-malaysia/): Compares paying credit card and other debts as they are (monthly interest on the balance; card minimum payment 5% of the balance or RM50, whichever is higher; card finance charges 15%, 17% or 18% a year by repayment record) with consolidating them into one personal loan (flat rate converted to EIR, 0.5% stamp duty). Example: RM15,000 of card debt at 18% paid at the minimum costs RM5,967.05 in interest; a 6% flat, 5-year loan costs RM325 a month with RM4,500 interest and RM75 stamp duty (10.85% EIR), saving RM1,392.05. A RM10,000 card balance at 18% paid at the minimum takes 89 months and RM4,054.96 in interest.
- [Education Cost Calculator Malaysia: How Much to Save for University](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/education-cost-calculator-malaysia/): Plans university savings for a child in Malaysia: each year of study costs today's yearly cost (fees and living costs) × (1 + education inflation)^years until that year, and the monthly saving needed from now = the amount needed when university starts (later years discounted at the savings return), less existing savings grown at that return, spread over the months left with monthly compounding. Example: a 5-year-old starting a 4-year degree at 18, costing RM25,000 a year today, with 5% inflation and a 4.10% return (the Simpan SSPN dividend for 2025) and RM5,000 already saved: the degree costs RM203,185 at future prices (RM47,141 in the first year) and needs RM889.77 a month. With nothing saved, starting at birth needs about RM768 a month, at 5 about RM931 and at 12 about RM1,665. Inflation and return are assumptions the user sets.
- [Employer Cost Calculator Malaysia 2026: EPF, SOCSO, EIS and HRD](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/employer-cost-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates what an employee really costs an employer in Malaysia: wages and fixed allowances, employer EPF (13% for wages up to RM5,000, 12% above; 4% from age 60; 2% for foreign workers from October 2025), employer SOCSO 1.75% (1.25% from age 60) and EIS 0.2% (not for foreign workers) by the contribution schedules, the HRD Corp levy of 1% for employers with 10 or more Malaysian employees in covered sectors or 0.5% voluntary for 5 to 9 (on Malaysian employees' wages only), and EPF on bonus. Example: RM3,000 salary with the 1% HRD levy: EPF RM390, SOCSO RM51.65, EIS RM5.90, HRD RM30, total RM3,477.55 a month (15.9% on top of pay) and RM41,730.60 a year.
- [EPF Calculator Malaysia 2026: KWSP Dividend & Retirement](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/epf-calculator/): Projects EPF (KWSP) savings to age 55 or 60 from age, salary, yearly raise, current balances in Akaun Persaraan, Sejahtera and Fleksibel, own contribution rate and voluntary top-ups, using the KWSP Third Schedule, the 75/15/10 account split and EPF's dividend method; compares the inflation-adjusted result with EPF's Basic (RM390,000), Adequate (RM650,000) and Enhanced (RM1.3 million) benchmarks. Includes dividend history 2016–2025 (2025: 6.15%).
- [Fidyah Calculator Malaysia 2026: Fidyah Rates by State](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/fidyah-calculator/): Calculates fidyah for missed Ramadan fasts in Malaysia at each state's 2026 rate (one cupak of the staple food a day, paid in money): Selangor RM2.00, RM4.30 or RM6.30 by rice type; Federal Territories RM4.00; Johor RM1.75, RM3.00 or RM5.00; Perak RM2.75, RM4.40 or RM7.45; Kedah RM2.00 or RM4.00; Perlis RM5.00; Terengganu RM2.50; Kelantan and Melaka RM2.00; Negeri Sembilan, Sabah and Sarawak RM1.90; Penang and Pahang RM1.75. Under the relied-upon Shafi'i view, delaying the qada past the next Ramadan without a valid reason adds one fidyah a day for every Ramadan passed; those unable to fast (old age, chronic illness) pay one fidyah a day without qada; pregnant or nursing women who did not fast for fear for the child make up the fast and pay one fidyah a day.
- [Fixed Deposit Calculator Malaysia 2026: FD Interest and Returns](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/fixed-deposit-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates fixed deposit interest in Malaysia: simple interest for the tenure = deposit × rate × months ÷ 12, paid at maturity or monthly; renewing at maturity compounds it. Example: RM10,000 at 3.8% for 12 months earns RM380 (RM10,380 at maturity, or RM31.67 a month); 6 months RM190; renewed for 5 years it grows to RM12,050. PIDM protects up to RM250,000 per depositor per member bank, interest included, with Islamic and conventional deposits protected separately. Interest from licensed banks is tax-exempt for resident individuals. OPR 2.75% (held on 3 September 2026); headline inflation averaged 1.9% in Q2 2026.
- [Freelance Rate Calculator Malaysia 2026: Hourly and Day Rate](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/freelance-rate-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates the rate a freelancer in Malaysia must charge: yearly revenue = take-home target + business expenses + EPF savings (i-Saraan or voluntary, a % of profit) + optional SOCSO self-employment (SKSPS) + resident income tax (YA2026 rates, self relief RM9,000, EPF relief up to RM4,000, RM400 rebate if chargeable income is RM35,000 or less); hourly rate = revenue ÷ billable hours (hours a week × weeks worked). Example: RM5,000 a month take-home, RM500 a month expenses, 11% EPF, 30 billable hours a week and 6 weeks off: revenue RM75,961.54 a year (RM6,330.13 a month), tax RM2,265.77, EPF RM7,695.77, 1,380 billable hours, so charge RM55.04 an hour or RM440.36 a day. Freelance income is business income, declared on Form B by 30 June.
- [Fuel Cost Calculator Malaysia 2026: Petrol Price and RM per km](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/fuel-cost-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates fuel cost in Malaysia: litres needed (distance × L/100 km ÷ 100), fuel cost, tolls, cost per km and per person, return trips, monthly cost and the BUDI95 split (RON95 at RM1.99 a litre for eligible Malaysians up to 300 litres a month from 1 September 2026, the rest at the market price); also measures a car's fuel consumption by the full-tank method (km ÷ litres). Weekly retail prices for subsidised and unsubsidised RON95, RON97, Peninsular diesel, Sabah/Sarawak/Labuan diesel and BUDI Diesel are taken every week from the Ministry of Finance's official data on data.gov.my.
- [Gambar ke Prompt AI: Tukar Foto Jadi Prompt Percuma](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/gambar-ke-prompt/): Alat Bahasa Melayu yang menukar gambar kepada prompt AI gambar atau video. Pelayar membaca palet warna, kecerahan dan nisbah aspek gambar; model penglihatan (Meta Llama 3.2 11B Vision di Cloudflare Workers AI) menerangkan subjek, aksi, latar, gaya, pencahayaan, sudut kamera, suasana dan warna; jika perkhidmatan itu sibuk atau had percuma harian habis, pengguna boleh menjalankan model kapsyen kecil dalam pelayar (Transformers.js, kira-kira 250 MB dimuat turun sekali). Penerangan yang boleh disunting ditulis sebagai tiga variasi prompt untuk Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, ChatGPT/DALL·E, Flux, Veo, Sora, Kling atau Runway, dan boleh dibuka dalam Penjana Prompt AI. Gambar dikecilkan ke 560 piksel dan tidak disimpan.
- [GDEX Tracking: Track Your GDEX Parcel in Malaysia](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/gdex-tracking/): GDEX (GD Express) tracking: opens GDEX's official tracking page for a consignment note number, explains the number format, common GDEX statuses, what to do when a parcel is undelivered, and background on GD Express Carrier Bhd.
- [Gold Price Malaysia Today: 999 & 916 per Gram (Live), Kijang Emas](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/gold-price-malaysia/): Shows today's gold price in Malaysia in ringgit per gram for 999 (24K), 916 (22K), 835 (20K), 750 (18K), 585 (14K) and 375 (9K) gold, worked out from the international spot price (USD per troy ounce) × USD/MYR ÷ 31.1034768 and refreshed every minute, alongside Bank Negara Malaysia's official Kijang Emas gold coin buying and selling prices (1 oz, ½ oz, ¼ oz), a Kijang Emas price chart, a jewellery price check (weight × purity price + making charge, against the shop's price) and a link to the gold zakat calculator.
- [Gold Zakat Calculator Malaysia 2026: Worn Gold, Uruf, Savings](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/gold-zakat-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates zakat on gold and savings in Malaysia at 2.5%: kept gold (bars, coins, gold accounts) once it reaches the 85 g nisab, worn gold only on the weight above the state's uruf (Selangor and the Federal Territories 800 g, Kelantan 600 g, other states entered by the user), and savings that stay at or above the nisab for a full year (haul); the gold price per gram is editable (default RM455.86, implied by Selangor's RM38,748 nisab for July–December 2026) and zakat paid qualifies for the income tax rebate.
- [Harga Emas Hari Ini Malaysia: 999 & 916 Segram (Live), Kijang Emas](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/harga-emas-hari-ini/): Menunjukkan harga emas hari ini di Malaysia dalam ringgit segram bagi ketulenan 999 (24K), 916 (22K), 835 (20K), 750 (18K), 585 (14K) dan 375 (9K), dikira daripada harga spot emas antarabangsa (USD seauns troy) × kadar USD/MYR ÷ 31.1034768 dan dikemas kini setiap minit, bersama harga belian dan jualan rasmi syiling Kijang Emas Bank Negara Malaysia (1 auns, ½ auns, ¼ auns), carta harga Kijang Emas, dan kalkulator semakan harga barang kemas (berat × harga ketulenan + upah, berbanding harga kedai) serta pautan ke kalkulator zakat emas.
- [Hijri Date Converter Malaysia: Islamic to Gregorian Calendar](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/hijri-date-converter/): Converts Hijri to Gregorian and Gregorian to Hijri dates from 1400 AH to 1500 AH (21 November 1979 to 16 November 2077) on Malaysia's official takwim: month starts follow the MABIMS imkanur rukyah criteria used by JAKIM (from 1443 AH, crescent altitude at least 3° and elongation at least 6.4° at sunset), matching every official takwim date checked from 1443 AH to 1449 AH. Shows today's Hijri date, the weekday, the length of the Hijri month, a 12-month table and key dates (Awal Muharram, Maulidur Rasul, Isra and Miraj, the first of Ramadan, Nuzul al-Quran, Hari Raya Aidilfitri, the Day of Arafah, Aidiladha). Ramadan, Shawwal and Dhu al-Hijjah remain subject to the moon-sighting announcement by the Keeper of the Rulers' Seal.
- [Home Loan Calculator Malaysia 2026: Instalment, Stamp Duty & DSR](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/home-loan-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates the monthly instalment of a Malaysian housing loan (monthly rest), total interest, a yearly amortisation table and savings from extra monthly payments; estimates upfront costs: down payment, stamp duty on the transfer (1%/2%/3%/4% scale) and loan agreement (0.5%), SRO 2023 legal fees (1.25% of the first RM500,000, 1% after) plus 8% SST, and the first-home stamp duty exemption (current RM500,000 rule and the Budget 2027 RM750,000 proposal); checks the debt service ratio and the maximum loan for an income. OPR 2.75% since 9 July 2025.
- [HTML Beautifier, Formatter & Minifier Online Free](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/html-beautifier/): Beautifies HTML with js-beautify (indent size or tabs, line wrap, attribute wrapping, inline CSS and JavaScript formatting, template-aware) and minifies it with html-minifier-terser using four presets: Safe (renders identically, keeps one space between inline elements), Maximum (removes optional tags and attribute quotes, sorts attributes for gzip), Blogger and XML templates (keeps case and closing slashes, re-wraps scripts containing < or & in CDATA) and Email (keeps Outlook conditional comments). Every option can be fine-tuned. Also checks HTML and reports unclosed and mismatched tags, duplicate ids, images without alt or width and height (layout shift), empty links and buttons, unlabeled form fields, obsolete tags and missing title, viewport, lang or h1, each with its line number. Includes a sandboxed preview. Runs in a Web Worker; code is never uploaded.
- [Iddah Calculator Malaysia: Waiting Period After Divorce or Death](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/iddah-calculator/): Calculates the iddah (waiting period) and ihdad (mourning) for Muslim women in Malaysia under the Shafi'i school and JAKIM's Garis Panduan Ber'iddah: divorce after consummation while still menstruating, three quru' (periods of purity), ending when the third menstruation after the talak begins, at least 32 days if divorced while pure or 47 if during menstruation, with dates estimated from the last period and cycle length; not menstruating (menopause, never, or medical), three Hijri months; pregnant, until delivery; divorce before consummation, no iddah. Husband's death: four Hijri months and ten days (about 130 days) even before consummation, or until delivery if pregnant, with ihdad required throughout. Hijri months follow Malaysia's official takwim (MABIMS imkanur rukyah criteria).
- [Image to Prompt: Free AI Photo to Prompt Generator](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/image-to-prompt/): Turns an uploaded picture into AI image or video prompts. The browser reads the picture's colour palette, brightness and aspect ratio; a vision model (Meta Llama 3.2 11B Vision on Cloudflare Workers AI) describes the subject, action, setting, style, lighting, framing, mood and colours as JSON; if that service is busy or its free daily allowance is used up, the visitor can run a small captioning model in the browser instead (Transformers.js, about 250 MB downloaded once). The editable description is written as three prompt variations for Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, ChatGPT/DALL·E, Flux, Veo, Sora, Kling or Runway, and can be opened in the AI Prompt Generator. Pictures are resized to 560 px and not stored; it cannot recover the exact prompt that made an AI image, only describe what is visible.
- [Income Tax Calculator Malaysia YA2026 & Budget 2027](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/income-tax-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates Malaysian resident individual income tax for YA2026 (income earned in 2026, filed in 2027) from annual income, every personal relief with its limit, approved donations, the RM400 rebate, zakat and PCB already paid (refund or balance), and compares it with the Budget 2027 proposal (RM12,000 individual relief, 18% and 24% bands, 30% above RM1 million) for YA2027.
- [JavaScript Minifier & Obfuscator: Minify JS Online Free](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/javascript-minifier/): Minifies JavaScript with Terser 5 (the minifier used by webpack and Vite) in a Web Worker in the browser: compression passes, variable renaming, top-level renaming, ES module mode, drop console/debugger, keep licence comments, keep function and class names, output ECMAScript level, source maps. Also obfuscates with javascript-obfuscator (low, medium, high presets; optional domain lock) and beautifies minified code. Can wrap output in a CDATA script block for Blogger XML themes. Reports syntax errors with line and column. On jQuery 3.7.1 it produces 86,987 bytes against the official 87,533-byte jquery.min.js. Code is never uploaded.
- [J&T Near Me: Find the Nearest J&T Express Drop Point](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/jnt-near-me/): Finds J&T Express drop points near the visitor by opening a Google Maps search at their location or a typed area; explains how to send a parcel at a J&T drop point, opening hours, marketplace drop-offs and what to bring.
- [J&T Terdekat: Cari Drop Point J&T Express Berhampiran](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/jnt-terdekat/): Mencari drop point J&T Express berhampiran pelawat dengan membuka carian Google Maps di lokasi mereka atau kawasan yang ditaip; menerangkan cara menghantar parcel di drop point J&T, waktu operasi, penghantaran pesanan marketplace dan apa perlu dibawa.
- [J&T Tracking Malaysia: Track Your J&T Express Parcel](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/jnt-tracking/): J&T Express Malaysia tracking: opens J&T Malaysia's official tracking page for a waybill number (usually 12 digits), explains J&T statuses such as Picked Up, Arrival, Departure, On Delivery and On Hold, why scans have gaps and when to contact the seller or J&T.
- [Kalkulator Bil Air 2026: Tarif Air Domestik Ikut Negeri](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-bil-air/): Mengira bil air domestik (meter individu) di Malaysia ikut negeri dengan tarif blok: kadar setiap blok hanya untuk air dalam blok itu (0–20 m³, 20–35 m³, melebihi 35 m³ sebulan), dengan caj minimum bulanan, dan tiada SST atas air domestik. Kadar semasa setiap m³: Selangor, Kuala Lumpur dan Putrajaya (Air Selangor, mulai 1 September 2025) RM0.65 / RM1.62 / RM3.51, minimum RM6.50; Johor (Ranhill SAJ, 1 Ogos 2025) RM1.05 / RM2.35 / RM3.50, minimum RM10.50; Pulau Pinang (PBAPP, 1 Julai 2026) RM0.65 / RM1.30 / RM2.21, minimum RM6.50; Melaka (SAMB, 1 Ogos 2025) RM0.94 / RM1.69 / RM2.26, minimum RM9.40; Kedah (SADA, 1 Ogos 2025) RM0.81 / RM1.48 / RM2.00, minimum RM8.10; Kelantan (Air Kelantan, 10 September 2025) RM0.80 / RM1.55 / RM2.10, minimum RM8.00; Terengganu (SATU, 1 Ogos 2025) RM0.66 / RM1.69 / RM2.25, minimum RM6.60. Contoh bil 30 m³: Selangor RM29.20, Johor RM44.50, Pulau Pinang RM26.00, Melaka RM35.70, Kedah RM31.00, Kelantan RM31.50, Terengganu RM30.10. Pulau Pinang 35 m³ = RM32.50 (contoh PBAPP sendiri).
- [Kalkulator Bil Elektrik TNB 2026: Kira Bil Ikut Tarif Baharu](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-bil-elektrik-tnb/): Mengira bil elektrik domestik TNB (Semenanjung Malaysia) mengikut tarif RP4 mulai 1 Julai 2025: caj tenaga 27.03 sen/kWj (hingga 1,500 kWj), caj kapasiti 4.55 sen/kWj dan caj rangkaian 12.85 sen/kWj, tolak Insentif Kecekapan Tenaga (EEI) bagi penggunaan hingga 1,000 kWj (kadar jalur × semua kWj, 25 sen bagi 1–200 kWj hingga 0.5 sen bagi 901–1,000 kWj); AFA (pelarasan bahan api bulanan), caj peruncitan RM10 dan SST 8% (atas kWj melebihi paras perlindungan) hanya dikenakan melebihi paras perlindungan 600 kWj, yang dinaikkan kepada 800 kWj bagi September hingga Disember 2026; KWTBB 1.6% melebihi 300 kWj. Contoh: 200 kWj RM38.86, 300 kWj RM65.79, 600 kWj RM215.98.
- [Kalkulator BMI Malaysia: Had Asia KKM, Berat Ideal, Pinggang](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-bmi/): Mengira indeks jisim badan (BMI) dewasa dalam unit metrik atau imperial dan mengelaskannya mengikut Garis Panduan Amalan Klinikal Pengurusan Obesiti Malaysia (had Asia: kurang berat badan di bawah 18.5, sihat 18.5–22.9, berlebihan berat badan 23.0–27.4, obes kelas I 27.5–34.9, kelas II 35.0–39.9, kelas III 40 dan ke atas) bersama kategori antarabangsa WHO; memberi julat berat sihat bagi ketinggian dan berapa kilogram perlu diturunkan atau dinaikkan, serta menyemak lilitan pinggang (risiko dari 90 cm lelaki dan 80 cm wanita) dan nisbah pinggang kepada ketinggian (pinggang kurang daripada separuh ketinggian).
- [Kalkulator Caj Freelance 2026: Kadar Sejam dan Sehari](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-caj-freelance/): Mengira kadar yang perlu dicaj oleh freelancer di Malaysia: jualan setahun = pendapatan bersih sasaran + kos perniagaan + simpanan KWSP (i-Saraan atau sukarela, % daripada untung) + PERKESO bekerja sendiri (SKSPS) jika ada + cukai pendapatan pemastautin (kadar TT2026, pelepasan diri RM9,000, pelepasan KWSP hingga RM4,000, rebat RM400 jika pendapatan bercukai RM35,000 atau kurang); kadar sejam = jualan ÷ jam boleh caj (jam seminggu × minggu bekerja). Contoh: pendapatan bersih RM5,000 sebulan, kos RM500 sebulan, KWSP 11%, 30 jam boleh caj seminggu dan 6 minggu cuti: jualan RM75,961.54 setahun (RM6,330.13 sebulan), cukai RM2,265.77, KWSP RM7,695.77, 1,380 jam boleh caj, jadi caj RM55.04 sejam atau RM440.36 sehari. Pendapatan freelance ialah pendapatan perniagaan, diisytihar dalam Borang B sebelum 30 Jun.
- [Kalkulator Cukai Pendapatan TT2026 & Bajet 2027](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-cukai-pendapatan/): Kalkulator cukai pendapatan individu pemastautin Malaysia bagi TT2026 (pendapatan 2026, diisytihar pada 2027): pendapatan tahunan, setiap pelepasan cukai dengan hadnya, derma diluluskan, rebat RM400, zakat dan PCB yang telah dipotong (bayaran balik atau baki), berserta perbandingan dengan cadangan Bajet 2027 (pelepasan individu RM12,000, kadar 18% dan 24%, 30% melebihi RM1 juta) bagi TT2027.
- [Kalkulator Dividen ASB 2026: Dividen Tahunan, Unjuran & Loan ASB](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-dividen-asb/): Mengira agihan pendapatan Amanah Saham Bumiputera (ASB), iaitu dividen dan bonus, daripada purata baki terendah setiap bulan, sama ada daripada baki awal dan simpanan bulanan atau dua belas baki terendah bulanan yang tepat; mengunjurkan baki sehingga 40 tahun dengan dividen dilabur semula dan had pelaburan RM200,000; serta membandingkan ansuran dan faedah pembiayaan ASB dengan dividen yang diperoleh. Termasuk sejarah agihan ASB 2019–2025 (TK2025: 5.75 sen, dividen 5.20 sen + bonus 0.55 sen).
- [Kalkulator Fidyah 2026: Kadar Fidyah Puasa Mengikut Negeri](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-fidyah/): Mengira fidyah puasa Ramadan di Malaysia mengikut kadar 2026 setiap negeri (satu cupak makanan asasi sehari, dibayar dalam wang): Selangor RM2.00, RM4.30 atau RM6.30 ikut jenis beras; Wilayah Persekutuan RM4.00; Johor RM1.75, RM3.00 atau RM5.00; Perak RM2.75, RM4.40 atau RM7.45; Kedah RM2.00 atau RM4.00; Perlis RM5.00; Terengganu RM2.50; Kelantan dan Melaka RM2.00; Negeri Sembilan, Sabah dan Sarawak RM1.90; Pulau Pinang dan Pahang RM1.75. Mengikut pendapat muktamad mazhab Syafie, menangguh qada melepasi Ramadan berikutnya tanpa uzur menambah satu fidyah sehari bagi setiap Ramadan yang berlalu; yang tidak mampu berpuasa (tua, sakit kronik) membayar satu fidyah sehari tanpa qada; wanita hamil atau menyusu yang tidak berpuasa kerana bimbangkan anak perlu qada dan membayar satu fidyah sehari.
- [Kalkulator Fixed Deposit (FD) 2026: Kira Faedah Simpanan Tetap](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-fixed-deposit/): Mengira faedah simpanan tetap (fixed deposit) di Malaysia: faedah mudah bagi tempoh = deposit × kadar × bulan ÷ 12, dibayar semasa matang atau setiap bulan; memperbaharui semasa matang mengkompaunkannya. Contoh: RM10,000 pada 3.8% selama 12 bulan menghasilkan RM380 (matang RM10,380, atau RM31.67 sebulan); 6 bulan RM190; diperbaharui 5 tahun menjadi RM12,050. PIDM melindungi sehingga RM250,000 bagi setiap pendeposit di setiap bank ahli, termasuk faedah, dan deposit Islam serta konvensional dilindungi berasingan. Faedah daripada bank berlesen dikecualikan cukai bagi individu pemastautin. OPR 2.75% (dikekalkan 3 September 2026); inflasi utama purata 1.9% pada suku kedua 2026.
- [Kalkulator Gabung Hutang Kad Kredit: Berbaloi atau Tidak?](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-gabung-hutang/): Membandingkan membayar hutang kad kredit dan hutang lain seperti biasa (faedah bulanan atas baki; bayaran minimum kad 5% baki atau RM50, mana lebih tinggi; caj kewangan kad 15%, 17% atau 18% setahun mengikut rekod bayaran) dengan menyatukannya ke dalam satu pinjaman peribadi (kadar rata ditukar kepada EIR, duti setem 0.5%). Contoh: hutang kad RM15,000 pada 18% dibayar minimum menelan faedah RM5,967.05; pinjaman 6% kadar rata 5 tahun berbayar RM325 sebulan dengan faedah RM4,500 dan duti setem RM75 (EIR 10.85%), menjimatkan RM1,392.05. Hutang kad RM10,000 pada 18% dengan bayaran minimum mengambil 89 bulan dan faedah RM4,054.96.
- [Kalkulator Gaji Prorata: Mula Kerja, Berhenti & Cuti Tanpa Gaji](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-gaji-prorata/): Mengira gaji prorata (bulan tidak lengkap) di Malaysia bagi pekerja baharu, pekerja yang berhenti atau cuti tanpa gaji menggunakan seksyen 18A Akta Kerja 1955 (gaji bulanan ÷ hari kalendar dalam bulan × hari layak, berkuat kuasa sejak 1 Januari 2023), dan membandingkannya dengan kaedah hari bekerja (Isnin–Jumaat, Isnin–Sabtu, Ahad–Khamis atau separuh hari Sabtu) serta kadar gaji biasa 26 hari; menunjukkan kadar harian dan potongan.
- [Kalkulator Gaji Bersih 2026: PCB, KWSP, PERKESO & SIP](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-gaji/): Kalkulator gaji bersih Malaysia 2026 (Bahasa Melayu): potongan KWSP mengikut Jadual Ketiga, PERKESO, SIP dan LINDUNG 24 Jam (siling RM6,000) serta PCB/MTD mengikut kaedah pengiraan berkomputer LHDN, termasuk kos majikan.
- [Kalkulator Hari Bekerja 2026-2027 Ikut Negeri](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-hari-bekerja/): Mengira hari bekerja di Malaysia ikut negeri bagi 2026 dan 2027: jumlah hari tolak hujung minggu negeri (Jumaat dan Sabtu di Kedah, Kelantan dan Terengganu; Sabtu dan Ahad di negeri lain, termasuk Johor sejak 1 Januari 2025) dan cuti umum persekutuan dan negeri yang jatuh pada hari bekerja, termasuk cuti ganti, kemudian tolak cuti tahunan. Juga menambah N hari bekerja kepada tarikh mula untuk tarikh akhir. Hasil: Selangor ada 248 hari bekerja pada 2027 (244 pada 2026); Kuala Lumpur 247, Johor 248, Kedah 244, Kelantan 241 dan Terengganu 239 pada 2027. November 2026 ada 20 hari bekerja di Selangor (Deepavali jatuh Ahad 8 November, diganti Isnin 9 November). 14 hari bekerja dari 14 Oktober 2026 di Selangor berakhir pada 3 November 2026. Tarikh cuti Islam tertakluk kepada rukyah rasmi.
- [Kalkulator Iddah 2026: Kira Tempoh Iddah Cerai dan Kematian Suami](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-iddah/): Mengira tempoh iddah dan ihdad bagi wanita Islam di Malaysia (mazhab Syafie, Garis Panduan Ber'iddah JAKIM): cerai selepas bersetubuh dan masih haid, tiga kali suci (quru') yang tamat apabila haid ketiga selepas talak bermula, sekurang-kurangnya 32 hari jika talak semasa suci atau 47 hari jika semasa haid, dengan anggaran tarikh daripada tarikh haid terakhir dan kitaran; tiada haid (putus haid, belum haid atau sebab perubatan), tiga bulan Hijrah; hamil, hingga melahirkan anak; cerai sebelum bersetubuh, tiada iddah. Kematian suami: empat bulan Hijrah dan sepuluh hari (kira-kira 130 hari) walaupun belum bersetubuh, atau hingga bersalin jika hamil, dengan ihdad (berkabung) wajib sepanjang iddah. Bulan Hijrah mengikut takwim rasmi Malaysia (kriteria imkanur rukyah MABIMS).
- [Kalkulator Kos Pekerja Majikan 2026: KWSP, PERKESO, SIP dan HRD](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-kos-pekerja/): Mengira kos sebenar seorang pekerja kepada majikan di Malaysia: gaji dan elaun tetap, KWSP majikan (13% bagi gaji hingga RM5,000, 12% melebihi; 4% bagi pekerja 60 tahun ke atas; 2% bagi pekerja asing mulai Oktober 2025), PERKESO majikan 1.75% (1.25% bagi 60 tahun ke atas) dan SIP 0.2% (bukan bagi pekerja asing) mengikut jadual caruman, levi HRD Corp 1% bagi majikan dengan 10 atau lebih pekerja Malaysia dalam sektor diliputi atau 0.5% secara sukarela bagi 5 hingga 9 pekerja (atas gaji pekerja Malaysia sahaja), serta KWSP atas bonus. Contoh: gaji RM3,000 dengan levi HRD 1%: KWSP RM390, PERKESO RM51.65, SIP RM5.90, HRD RM30, jumlah RM3,477.55 sebulan (15.9% di atas gaji) dan RM41,730.60 setahun.
- [Kalkulator Kos Pendidikan Anak: Berapa Perlu Simpan untuk Universiti](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-kos-pendidikan-anak/): Merancang simpanan universiti anak di Malaysia: kos setiap tahun pengajian = kos setahun hari ini (yuran dan kos sara hidup) × (1 + inflasi pendidikan)^tahun hingga tahun itu, dan simpanan bulanan diperlukan dari sekarang = jumlah diperlukan pada permulaan universiti (tahun berikutnya didiskaun pada pulangan simpanan), tolak simpanan sedia ada yang berkembang pada pulangan itu, dibahagi atas bulan yang tinggal dengan pengkompaunan bulanan. Contoh: anak berumur 5 tahun memulakan ijazah 4 tahun pada umur 18, berkos RM25,000 setahun hari ini, dengan inflasi 5% dan pulangan 4.10% (dividen Simpan SSPN bagi 2025) serta RM5,000 sudah disimpan: ijazah berkos RM203,185 pada harga masa depan (RM47,141 pada tahun pertama) dan memerlukan RM889.77 sebulan. Tanpa simpanan, bermula sejak lahir memerlukan kira-kira RM768 sebulan, umur 5 kira-kira RM931 dan umur 12 kira-kira RM1,665. Inflasi dan pulangan ialah andaian pengguna.
- [Kalkulator KWSP 2026: Dividen & Simpanan Persaraan](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-kwsp/): Kalkulator KWSP (Bahasa Melayu): unjuran simpanan hingga umur 55 atau 60 berdasarkan umur, gaji, kenaikan gaji tahunan, baki semasa Akaun Persaraan, Sejahtera dan Fleksibel, kadar caruman sendiri dan caruman sukarela, mengikut Jadual Ketiga KWSP, pembahagian 75/15/10 dan kaedah dividen KWSP; membandingkan nilai selepas inflasi dengan tahap Asas (RM390,000), Mencukupi (RM650,000) dan Dipertingkat (RM1.3 juta). Termasuk sejarah dividen 2016–2025 (2025: 6.15%).
- [Kalkulator Loan Kereta 2026: Ansuran, Cukai Jalan & Insurans](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-loan-kereta/): Mengira ansuran pinjaman kereta (sewa beli) Malaysia dengan kaedah baki berkurangan dan kadar faedah efektif (EIR), diwajibkan oleh Akta Sewa Beli (Pindaan) mulai 1 Jun 2026 dengan peralihan hingga 31 Mac 2027, atau kaedah kadar rata lama; menukar kadar rata kepada EIR dan sebaliknya; menunjukkan jumlah faedah, jadual tahunan dan jumlah penyelesaian awal termasuk rebat Rule of 78 bagi perjanjian kadar rata lama; turut menganggar cukai jalan JPJ mengikut cc enjin (salun atau bukan salun Semenanjung, salun Sabah dan Sarawak) atau kuasa motor bagi kereta elektrik hingga 310 kW dan insurans komprehensif dengan NCD, SST 8% dan duti setem, serta jumlah kos bulanan memiliki kereta.
- [Kalkulator Margin Untung: Kira Margin, Markup dan Harga Jual](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-margin-untung/): Mengira margin untung untuk peniaga di Malaysia: untung seunit = harga jual − kos barang − fi peratusan (komisen marketplace, fi bayaran dan servis) − fi tetap setiap pesanan − kos penghantaran ditanggung − kos iklan seunit; margin = untung ÷ harga jual; markup = untung ÷ kos; harga pulang modal = (kos + kos tetap) ÷ (1 − fi %); harga untuk margin sasaran = (kos + kos tetap) ÷ (1 − fi % − margin sasaran). Contoh: harga jual RM100, kos RM60 dan fi 10% memberi untung RM30, margin 30% dan markup 50%; harga pulang modal RM66.67; margin 40% memerlukan RM120. Margin sentiasa lebih kecil daripada markup: margin 25% sama dengan markup 33.3%, margin 50% sama dengan markup 100%. Kadar fi dimasukkan sendiri kerana platform kerap mengubahnya.
- [Kalkulator Minyak 2026: Kira Kos Petrol RON95, RON97 dan Diesel](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-minyak/): Mengira kos minyak perjalanan di Malaysia: liter diperlukan (jarak × L/100 km ÷ 100), kos minyak, tol, kos sekilometer dan kos seorang, pergi balik, kos sebulan dan pembahagian kuota BUDI95 (RON95 RM1.99 seliter bagi rakyat Malaysia layak hingga 300 liter sebulan mulai 1 September 2026, lebihan pada harga pasaran); juga mengira penggunaan minyak kereta dengan kaedah isi penuh (km ÷ liter). Harga runcit mingguan RON95 bersubsidi dan tanpa subsidi, RON97, diesel Semenanjung, diesel Sabah/Sarawak/Labuan dan BUDI Diesel diambil setiap minggu daripada data rasmi Kementerian Kewangan di data.gov.my.
- [Kalkulator NCD 2026: Diskaun Tanpa Tuntutan Insurans Kereta](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-ncd/): Mengira diskaun tanpa tuntutan (NCD) insurans kenderaan di Malaysia mengikut jadual tarif motor yang masih digunakan semua syarikat insurans dan takaful: kereta persendirian 0%, 25%, 30%, 38.33%, 45% dan 55% selepas 0 hingga 5 tahun atau lebih tanpa tuntutan; motosikal dan kenderaan perdagangan 0%, 15%, 20% dan 25%. Premium = premium kasar − NCD, ditambah SST 8% dan duti setem RM10. Tuntutan kerosakan sendiri atau kecurian mengembalikan NCD kepada 0% pada pembaharuan seterusnya; alat ini mengira premium tambahan yang dibayar sepanjang tempoh NCD naik semula (RM2,952.07 bagi premium kasar RM2,000 pada NCD 55%) supaya pengguna boleh menentukan sama ada lebih murah membayar kos baiki sendiri.
- [Kalkulator OT 2026: Kira Gaji Lebih Masa Ikut Akta Kerja 1955](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-ot/): Mengira bayaran kerja lebih masa (OT) di Malaysia mengikut Akta Kerja 1955 seperti dipinda mulai 1 Januari 2023: kadar gaji biasa (gaji bulanan ÷ 26, atau gaji harian), kadar gaji sejam (ORP ÷ waktu kerja biasa sehari), OT hari biasa 1.5×, kerja hari rehat (setengah atau satu hari ORP bagi gaji bulanan, satu atau dua hari bagi gaji harian) dan OT hari rehat 2×, kerja cuti umum dua hari ORP dan OT cuti umum 3×; menandakan had liputan RM4,000, pekerja manual dan Jadual Pertama lain, serta had OT 104 jam sebulan.
- [Kalkulator Pinjaman Peribadi 2026: Ansuran & Kadar Rata ke EIR](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-pinjaman-peribadi/): Mengira ansuran pinjaman peribadi Malaysia dengan kaedah kadar rata yang masih digunakan kebanyakan bank pada 2026 atau baki berkurangan (EIR), menukar kadar rata kepada kadar faedah efektif (contohnya 6% rata selama 5 tahun kira-kira 10.85% EIR), menambah duti setem 0.5% atas perjanjian pinjaman dan menunjukkan jumlah diterima, jumlah faedah, jumlah kos serta jadual baki tahunan; menyatakan larangan Bank Negara Malaysia terhadap kadar rata dan Rule of 78 bagi pembiayaan peribadi baharu mulai 1 Januari 2027 layanan top-up pinjaman rumah dan pinjaman bercagarkan rumah yang habis dibayar untuk kegunaan peribadi sebagai pembiayaan peribadi (tempoh maksimum 10 tahun) dari tarikh yang sama, serta had pemberi pinjam wang berlesen 12% (bercagar) dan 18% (tanpa cagaran) setahun.
- [Kalkulator Pinjaman Perumahan 2026: Ansuran Loan Rumah, Duti Setem](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-pinjaman-perumahan/): Mengira ansuran bulanan pinjaman perumahan Malaysia (rehat bulanan), jumlah faedah, jadual tahunan dan penjimatan bayaran tambahan; menganggar kos awal: wang pendahuluan, duti setem pindah milik (skala 1%/2%/3%/4%) dan perjanjian pinjaman (0.5%), yuran guaman SRO 2023 (1.25% bagi RM500,000 pertama, 1% seterusnya) serta SST 8%, dan pengecualian duti setem rumah pertama (peraturan semasa RM500,000 dan cadangan Bajet 2027 RM750,000); menyemak nisbah khidmat hutang (DSR) dan pinjaman maksimum. OPR 2.75% sejak 9 Julai 2025.
- [Kalkulator PTPTN 2026: Kira Bayaran Balik Bulanan dan Ujrah 1%](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-ptptn/): Mengira bayaran balik pinjaman PTPTN skim ujrah: ujrah 1% setahun ke atas prinsipal bagi tempoh bayaran balik (jumlah ujrah = prinsipal × 1% × tahun), dibahagi sama rata setiap bulan; contoh RM30,000 selama 15 tahun: ujrah RM4,500, ansuran RM191.67 sebulan; 20 tahun RM150 sebulan. Bayaran balik bermula 12 bulan selepas tamat pinjaman dan ujrah dikenakan mulai bulan ke-13. Bayaran penuh lebih awal membayar baki prinsipal dan ujrah hingga bulan semasa sahaja (RM20,000 selepas 5 tahun, jimat RM3,000 ujrah). Penstrukturan semula boleh melanjutkan tempoh hingga umur 60 dengan ansuran minimum kira-kira 5–8% pendapatan kasar. Tiada diskaun bayaran balik di bawah Belanjawan 2026.
- [Kalkulator Refinance Rumah 2026: Berbaloi atau Tidak?](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-refinance-rumah/): Mengira sama ada refinance pinjaman rumah di Malaysia berbaloi: ansuran baki pinjaman pada kadar semasa berbanding kadar baharu (baki yang sama), faedah dijimatkan, kos refinance (duti setem 0.5% atas pinjaman baharu tanpa pengecualian refinance, yuran guaman SRO 2023 1.25% bagi RM500,000 pertama dan 1% selebihnya, minimum RM500, ditambah SST 8%, penalti tempoh kunci, yuran penilaian dan kos lain), penjimatan bersih, tempoh pulang modal, serta pengeluaran tunai (cash-out). Contoh: baki RM300,000 selama 25 tahun dari 4.5% ke 3.9% menurunkan ansuran daripada RM1,667.50 kepada RM1,566.99, menjimatkan RM30,150.24 faedah; kos RM7,350 dan penjimatan bersih RM22,800.24, pulang modal 74 bulan. OPR 2.75% (dikekalkan 3 September 2026).
- [Kalkulator ROAS: Kira ROAS, ROI dan ROAS Pulang Modal Iklan](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-roas/): Mengira pulangan belanja iklan (ROAS) untuk iklan online di Malaysia: ROAS = jualan daripada iklan ÷ belanja iklan; untung selepas iklan = jualan × margin kasar − belanja iklan; ROI = untung ÷ belanja iklan; ROAS pulang modal = 1 ÷ margin kasar (margin 40% perlukan 2.5×, 25% perlukan 4×, 50% perlukan 2×); ACoS = belanja iklan ÷ jualan; CPA = belanja iklan ÷ pesanan; CPA pulang modal = nilai purata pesanan × margin. Contoh: belanja RM1,000, jualan RM4,000 dan margin 40% memberi ROAS 4.00×, untung RM600 dan ROI 60%; dengan 50 pesanan CPA ialah RM20 berbanding CPA pulang modal RM32. Jika invois mengenakan cukai perkhidmatan 8% atas perkhidmatan digital import (mulai 1 Mac 2024), belanja menjadi RM1,080, ROAS 3.70× dan untung RM520.
- [Kalkulator RPGT 2026: Cukai Keuntungan Harta Tanah (CKHT)](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-rpgt/): Mengira Cukai Keuntungan Harta Tanah (RPGT/CKHT) Malaysia bagi 2026 di bawah Jadual 5 Akta Cukai Keuntungan Harta Tanah 1976 (kadar sejak 1 Januari 2022): warganegara dan PR 30% dalam 3 tahun, 20% tahun ke-4, 15% tahun ke-5 dan 0% mulai tahun ke-6; bukan warganegara 30% dalam 5 tahun kemudian 10%; syarikat 30%, 20%, 15% kemudian 10%. Mengira tahun pemilikan daripada tarikh perolehan dan pelupusan, menolak kos perolehan, penambahbaikan dan pelupusan, menggunakan pengecualian individu RM10,000 atau 10% keuntungan (mana lebih tinggi) dan pengecualian rumah kediaman sekali seumur hidup, serta membandingkan cukai dengan wang tahanan oleh pembeli (3%; 5% bagi syarikat yang menjual dalam 3 tahun; 7% bagi penjual bukan warganegara). RPGT ditaksir sendiri sejak 1 Januari 2025.
- [Kalkulator Sewa atau Beli Rumah: Mana Lebih Untung?](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-sewa-atau-beli-rumah/): Membandingkan menyewa dengan membeli rumah di Malaysia: pembeli membayar wang pendahuluan, duti setem (dengan pengecualian rumah pertama hingga RM500,000), yuran guaman SRO 2023 dan SST di awal, kemudian ansuran dan kos penyelenggaraan; penyewa membayar sewa yang naik setiap tahun dan melaburkan kos permulaan pembeli serta perbezaan bulanan. Selepas tempoh dipilih, kekayaan pembeli = nilai rumah tolak kos jualan dan baki pinjaman; kekayaan penyewa = dana pelaburan. Contoh: rumah RM500,000, pendahuluan 10%, 4.2% selama 35 tahun (ansuran RM2,046.83, kos permulaan RM74,075), sewa RM1,800 naik 3% setahun, harga naik 3% setahun dan pulangan pelaburan 5%: selepas 10 tahun pembeli RM272,014 berbanding penyewa RM193,066; membeli mula untung pada tahun ke-5.
- [Kalkulator SSPN 2026: Simpanan, Dividen 4.10% dan Pelepasan Cukai](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-sspn/): Mengunjurkan simpanan Simpan SSPN (Skim Simpanan Pendidikan Nasional, PTPTN) dan pelepasan cukai: dividen tahunan dikreditkan atas purata baki bulanan (4.10% bagi 2025, tertinggi dalam 11 tahun; 4.05% bagi 2024; 3.60% bagi 2023), dan simpanan layak pelepasan cukai pendapatan hingga RM8,000 setahun bagi setiap pembayar cukai sehingga TT2027; cukai dijimat = cukai sebelum pelepasan − cukai selepas pelepasan pada kadar pemastautin TT2026. Contoh: RM200 sebulan selama 18 tahun pada 4.10% menjadi kira-kira RM63,497 (RM43,200 simpanan, RM20,297 dividen); simpanan RM2,400 setahun menjimatkan cukai RM264 pada pendapatan bercukai RM60,000; RM8,000 penuh (kira-kira RM667 sebulan) menjimatkan RM880 pada RM60,000 dan RM2,000 pada RM120,000. Simpan SSPN Prime dibuka dari RM20 tanpa komitmen bulanan; Simpan SSPN Plus bermula kira-kira RM30 sebulan dengan perlindungan takaful.
- [Kalkulator Ukuran Tanah: Relung, Ekar, Kaki Persegi & Hektar](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-ukuran-tanah/): Menukar keluasan tanah antara kaki persegi, meter persegi, ela persegi, hektar, ekar, rod, pole dan unit tradisional Malaysia iaitu relung (30,976 kaki persegi, digunakan di Kedah, Perlis dan Seberang Perai), jemba (64 kaki persegi) dan orlong (57,600 kaki persegi, Pulau Pinang dan Melaka); membaca geran lama dalam ekar, rod dan pole (cth. 2a 1r 20p), mengira keluasan lot segi empat daripada panjang dan lebar, dan memberi harga sekaki persegi, semeter persegi, seekar dan serelung.
- [Kalkulator Umur Bersara: Tarikh Bersara, Umur KWSP dan Pencen](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-umur-bersara/): Mengira persaraan di Malaysia: umur persaraan minimum pekerja swasta ialah 60 tahun (Akta Umur Persaraan Minimum 2012) dan penjawat awam bersara wajib pada 60 tahun, dengan persaraan pilihan dari umur 40 selepas sekurang-kurangnya 10 tahun perkhidmatan. Tarikh bersara ialah hari lahir pada umur dipilih (lahir 15 Mei 1990 bersara pada 15 Mei 2050, 23 tahun 7 bulan 1 hari selepas 14 Oktober 2026). Umur KWSP: 50 (pengeluaran Akaun Sejahtera), 55 (Akaun 55, keluar penuh), 60 (Akaun Emas; KWSP majikan turun ke 4% dan pekerja 0%), caruman wajib hingga 75. Penjawat awam berpencen: pencen bulanan = 1/600 × bulan perkhidmatan (hingga 360) × gaji pokok akhir, maksimum 60%; ganjaran = 7.5% × bulan perkhidmatan × gaji pokok akhir; sekurang-kurangnya 10 tahun (120 bulan) perkhidmatan. Contoh: 416 bulan dengan gaji RM5,000 memberi RM3,000 sebulan dan ganjaran RM156,000. Jawatan tetap baharu perkhidmatan awam akan tidak berpencen dengan caruman KWSP (keputusan Kabinet, Januari 2024).
- [Kalkulator Unit Trust: Pulangan Selepas Caj Jualan dan Yuran](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-unit-trust/): Mengira pulangan unit amanah (unit trust) di Malaysia: setiap pelaburan membeli unit pada NAB campur caj jualan (unit = amaun ÷ (NAB × (1 + caj))), dana berkembang pada pulangan kasar tolak yuran tahunan (pengurusan dan pemegang amanah) yang dikenakan setiap bulan atas nilai, dan pulangan bersih setahun ialah kadar pulangan dalaman aliran tunai anda. Contoh: RM10,000 campur RM300 sebulan selama 10 tahun pada pulangan kasar 7%, caj jualan 3% dan yuran tahunan 1.6% menjadi RM62,126 atas RM46,000 dilabur, pulangan bersih 4.83% setahun; pelan sama melalui KWSP i-Invest (had caj jualan 0.5%) memberi RM63,671, dan tanpa caj atau yuran RM71,277, jadi caj dan yuran berkos RM9,151. Caj jualan 5% atas RM10,000 mengambil RM476. Skim Pelaburan Ahli KWSP menghadkan caj jualan 0.5% dalam talian (i-Invest) dan 3% melalui ejen.
- [Kalkulator Zakat Emas & Simpanan 2026: Emas Pakai, Uruf, Nisab](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-zakat-emas/): Mengira zakat emas dan simpanan di Malaysia pada kadar 2.5%: emas simpan (jongkong, syiling, akaun emas) apabila beratnya mencapai nisab 85 g, emas pakai hanya atas berat yang melebihi uruf negeri (Selangor dan Wilayah Persekutuan 800 g, Kelantan 600 g, negeri lain dimasukkan sendiri), dan wang simpanan yang kekal melebihi nisab selama setahun (haul); harga emas segram boleh diubah (lalai RM455.86, tersirat daripada nisab Selangor RM38,748 Julai–Disember 2026) dan zakat yang dibayar layak rebat cukai pendapatan.
- [Kalkulator Zakat Pendapatan 2026: Nisab, Had Kifayah & Rebat Cukai](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-zakat-pendapatan/): Mengira zakat pendapatan di Malaysia pada kadar 2.5% apabila pendapatan setahun mencapai nisab (nilai 85 g emas; lalai RM38,748, Lembaga Zakat Selangor Julai–Disember 2026), dengan dua kaedah: tanpa tolakan (pendapatan kasar) atau dengan tolakan had kifayah LZS 2026 (dewasa bekerja RM4,944, dewasa tidak bekerja RM2,004, anak 7–17 tahun RM4,896, anak 6 tahun ke bawah RM2,100, tanggungan IPT RM7,356 setahun) dan caruman KWSP; memberi zakat setahun dan bulanan untuk potongan gaji, dan rebat cukai 100% di bawah seksyen 6A(3) Akta Cukai Pendapatan 1967 sehingga jumlah cukai.
- [Land Size Converter Malaysia: Acre, Relung, Sq Ft, Hectare](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/land-size-converter-malaysia/): Converts land area between square feet, square metres, square yards, hectares, acres, roods, poles and the traditional Malaysian units relung (30,976 sq ft, used in Kedah, Perlis and Seberang Perai), jemba (64 sq ft) and orlong (57,600 sq ft, Penang Island and Melaka); reads old land titles written in acres, roods and poles (e.g. 2a 1r 20p), works out the area of a rectangular lot from its length and width, and gives the price per square foot, square metre, acre and relung.
- [NCD Calculator Malaysia 2026: No Claim Discount on Car Insurance](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/ncd-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates the No Claim Discount (NCD) on Malaysian motor insurance using the former motor tariff scale that every insurer and takaful operator still applies: private cars 0%, 25%, 30%, 38.33%, 45% and 55% after 0 to 5 or more claim-free years; motorcycles and commercial vehicles 0%, 15%, 20% and 25%. Premium = gross premium − NCD, plus 8% SST and RM10 stamp duty. An own-damage or theft claim resets the NCD to 0% at the next renewal; the tool works out the extra premium paid while the NCD climbs back (RM2,952.07 on a RM2,000 gross premium at 55%) so drivers can decide whether paying for a repair themselves is cheaper.
- [Ninja Van Near Me: Find the Nearest Ninja Point to Drop Off](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/ninja-van-near-me/): Finds Ninja Van Ninja Points (pick-up and drop-off partner shops) near the visitor by opening a Google Maps search at their location or a typed area; explains dropping off, collecting a missed delivery, returns and opening hours.
- [Ninja Van Terdekat: Cari Ninja Point Berhampiran Anda](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/ninja-van-terdekat/): Mencari Ninja Point Ninja Van (kedai rakan untuk ambil dan hantar parcel) berhampiran pelawat dengan membuka carian Google Maps di lokasi mereka atau kawasan yang ditaip; menerangkan cara menghantar, mengambil parcel yang terlepas, pemulangan dan waktu operasi.
- [Ninja Van Tracking Malaysia: Track Your Parcel & Ninja Points](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/ninja-van-tracking/): Ninja Van Malaysia tracking: opens Ninja Van's official tracking page for a tracking ID (usually starting NV, NVMY or MYNJV), explains statuses such as Pending Pickup, Re-attempt, To Collect and Returned to Sender, and how Ninja Point pick-up and drop-off locations work.
- [Overtime Calculator Malaysia 2026: OT Pay by the Employment Act](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/overtime-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates overtime pay in Malaysia under the Employment Act 1955 as amended from 1 January 2023: ordinary rate of pay (monthly wages ÷ 26, or the daily wage), hourly rate (ORP ÷ normal daily hours), overtime on a normal day at 1.5×, rest-day work (half or one day's ORP for monthly-rated, one or two days for daily-rated) and rest-day overtime at 2×, public holiday work at two days' ORP and holiday overtime at 3×; flags the RM4,000 coverage threshold, manual and other First Schedule employees, and the 104-hour monthly overtime limit.
- [Parcel Tracking Malaysia: Track Pos Laju, J&T, SPX & Ninja Van](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/parcel-tracking-malaysia/): Identifies the Malaysian courier from a tracking number's format (Pos Laju, J&T Express, SPX Express, Ninja Van, DHL, GDEX, City-Link, Flash Express, Lazada LEX, Skynet, Line Clear, Aramex, FedEx, UPS) and opens that courier's official tracking page with the number copied; explains tracking number formats, what each tracking status means and what to do when a parcel stops moving. Runs in the browser; numbers are never sent to this site.
- [Penjana Prompt AI Percuma: Gambar dan Video (Midjourney, Veo)](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/penjana-prompt-ai/): Penjana prompt AI dalam Bahasa Melayu yang membina prompt gambar dan video daripada subjek serta pilihan gaya, pencahayaan, sudut kamera, lensa, suasana, warna, pergerakan kamera dan kelajuan, lalu menulisnya dalam format setiap platform dengan tiga variasi (pilihan anda, sinematik, artistik): Midjourney dengan parameter --ar, --no dan --stylize; Stable Diffusion sebagai kata kunci berkoma dengan prompt negatif berasingan dan kiraan token CLIP (kira-kira 75 token dibaca); ChatGPT/DALL·E dan Flux sebagai ayat biasa tanpa prompt negatif; Google Veo dan Sora dengan baris kamera, dialog dan audio; Runway dengan pergerakan kamera di depan; Kling dengan kotak prompt negatifnya sendiri. Prompt kekal dalam bahasa Inggeris kerana model AI paling memahaminya.
- [Personal Loan Calculator Malaysia 2026: Flat Rate to EIR](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/personal-loan-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates Malaysian personal loan instalments by the flat-rate method most banks still quote in 2026 or by reducing balance (EIR), converts a flat rate to its effective interest rate (for example 6% flat over 5 years is about 10.85% EIR), adds the 0.5% stamp duty on the loan agreement and shows the amount received, total interest, total cost and a yearly balance schedule; notes Bank Negara Malaysia's ban on flat-rate pricing and the Rule of 78 for new personal financing from 1 January 2027 the treatment of home loan top-ups and loans on fully paid property for personal use as personal financing (10-year maximum tenure) from the same date, and the licensed moneylender caps of 12% (secured) and 18% (unsecured) a year.
- [Pos Laju Near Me: Find the Nearest Post Office Open Now](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/pos-laju-near-me/): Finds Pos Malaysia post offices and Pos Laju outlets near the visitor by opening a Google Maps search at their location or a typed area; explains counter hours, state weekend differences, sending a Pos Laju parcel and collecting one.
- [Pos Laju Terdekat: Cari Pejabat Pos Berhampiran Anda](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/pos-laju-terdekat/): Mencari pejabat pos Pos Malaysia dan cawangan Pos Laju berhampiran pelawat dengan membuka carian Google Maps di lokasi mereka atau kawasan yang ditaip; menerangkan waktu kaunter, perbezaan hujung minggu mengikut negeri, menghantar dan mengambil parcel Pos Laju.
- [Pos Laju Tracking: Track Your Parcel & Status Meanings](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/pos-laju-tracking/): Pos Laju (Pos Malaysia) tracking: opens the official Pos Malaysia tracking page for a 13-character S10 tracking number, explains the number format and its service letters, each Pos Laju status, and collecting a parcel from a post office.
- [Profit Margin Calculator Malaysia: Margin, Markup and Selling Price](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/profit-margin-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates profit margin for Malaysian sellers: profit per unit = selling price − product cost − percentage fees (marketplace commission, payment and service fees) − fixed fees per order − shipping you pay − ad cost per unit; margin = profit ÷ selling price; markup = profit ÷ cost; break-even price = (cost + fixed costs) ÷ (1 − fee %); price for a target margin = (cost + fixed costs) ÷ (1 − fee % − target margin). Example: RM100 selling price, RM60 cost and 10% fees give RM30 profit, a 30% margin and 50% markup; break-even price RM66.67; a 40% margin needs RM120. Margin is always smaller than markup: a 25% margin equals a 33.3% markup and a 50% margin a 100% markup. Fee rates are entered by the seller because platforms change them.
- [Prorated Salary Calculator Malaysia: Joining, Leaving, Unpaid Leave](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/prorated-salary-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates prorated (partial-month) salary in Malaysia for a new joiner, a leaver or unpaid leave using section 18A of the Employment Act 1955 (monthly wages ÷ calendar days in the month × days eligible, in force since 1 January 2023), and compares it with the working-day method (Monday–Friday, Monday–Saturday, Sunday–Thursday or half-day Saturday) and the 26-day ordinary rate of pay; shows the daily rate and the deduction.
- [PTPTN Repayment Calculator 2026: Monthly Instalment and 1% Ujrah](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/ptptn-repayment-calculator/): Calculates PTPTN loan repayment under the ujrah scheme: ujrah of 1% a year on the principal for the repayment period (total ujrah = principal × 1% × years), spread evenly over the months; example RM30,000 over 15 years: RM4,500 ujrah, RM191.67 a month; 20 years RM150 a month. Repayment starts 12 months after the loan ends and ujrah is charged from the 13th month. Settling early pays the principal balance plus ujrah to the current month only (RM20,000 after 5 years, saving RM3,000 ujrah). Restructuring can extend the period to age 60 with a minimum instalment of about 5–8% of gross income. No repayment discount is offered under Budget 2026.
- [Refinance Calculator Malaysia 2026: Is Refinancing Worth It?](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/refinance-calculator-malaysia/): Works out whether refinancing a home loan in Malaysia pays off: the remaining balance's instalment at the current rate against the new rate (same balance), interest saved, refinancing costs (0.5% stamp duty on the new loan with no refinancing exemption, SRO 2023 legal fees of 1.25% on the first RM500,000 and 1% above, minimum RM500, plus 8% SST, lock-in penalty, valuation and other fees), net saving, break-even months and cash-out. Example: RM300,000 over 25 years from 4.5% to 3.9% cuts the instalment from RM1,667.50 to RM1,566.99, saving RM30,150.24 in interest; costs RM7,350 and the net saving is RM22,800.24, breaking even in 74 months. OPR 2.75% (held on 3 September 2026).
- [Rent vs Buy Calculator Malaysia: Which Leaves You Better Off?](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/rent-vs-buy-calculator-malaysia/): Compares renting with buying a home in Malaysia: the buyer pays the down payment, stamp duty (with the first-home exemption up to RM500,000), SRO 2023 legal fees and SST up front, then the instalment and upkeep; the renter pays rent rising each year and invests the buyer's up-front cost plus any monthly difference. After the chosen period, the buyer's wealth = home value less selling costs and the loan balance; the renter's = the investment pot. Example: a RM500,000 home, 10% down, 4.2% over 35 years (RM2,046.83 instalment, RM74,075 up front), rent of RM1,800 rising 3% a year, prices up 3% a year and a 5% investment return: after 10 years the buyer has RM272,014 against the renter's RM193,066; buying pulls ahead in year 5.
- [Retirement Age Calculator Malaysia: Date, EPF Ages and Pension](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/retirement-age-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates retirement in Malaysia: the minimum retirement age for private-sector employees is 60 (Minimum Retirement Age Act 2012) and civil servants retire compulsorily at 60, with optional retirement from 40 after at least 10 years' service. The retirement date is the birthday at the chosen age (born 15 May 1990 retires on 15 May 2050, 23 years 7 months 1 day after 14 October 2026). EPF ages: 50 (Akaun Sejahtera withdrawal), 55 (Akaun 55, full withdrawal), 60 (Akaun Emas; employer EPF drops to 4% and employee to 0%), contributions mandatory until 75. Pensionable civil servants: monthly pension = 1/600 × months of service (up to 360) × final basic salary, at most 60%; gratuity = 7.5% × months of service × final basic salary; at least 10 years' (120 months') service. Example: 416 months on RM5,000 gives RM3,000 a month and RM156,000 gratuity. New permanent civil service posts are to be non-pensionable with EPF instead (Cabinet decision, January 2024).
- [ROAS Calculator Malaysia: ROAS, ROI and Break-even ROAS](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/roas-calculator/): Calculates return on ad spend (ROAS) for online ads in Malaysia: ROAS = sales from ads ÷ ad spend; profit after ads = sales × gross margin − ad spend; ROI = profit ÷ ad spend; break-even ROAS = 1 ÷ gross margin (a 40% margin needs 2.5×, 25% needs 4×, 50% needs 2×); ACoS = ad spend ÷ sales; CPA = ad spend ÷ orders; break-even CPA = average order value × margin. Example: RM1,000 ad spend, RM4,000 sales and a 40% margin give ROAS 4.00×, RM600 profit and 60% ROI; with 50 orders CPA is RM20 against a break-even CPA of RM32. If the invoice adds Malaysia's 8% service tax on imported digital services (from 1 March 2024), spend becomes RM1,080, ROAS 3.70× and profit RM520.
- [RPGT Calculator Malaysia 2026: Real Property Gains Tax](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/rpgt-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates Malaysian Real Property Gains Tax (RPGT) for 2026 under Schedule 5 of the Real Property Gains Tax Act 1976 (rates since 1 January 2022): citizens and PRs 30% within 3 years, 20% in year 4, 15% in year 5 and 0% from year 6; non-citizens 30% within 5 years then 10%; companies 30%, 20%, 15% then 10%. Works out the holding year from the acquisition and disposal dates, deducts acquisition, enhancement and disposal costs, applies the individual exemption of RM10,000 or 10% of the gain (whichever is greater) and the once-in-a-lifetime private residence exemption, and compares the tax with the buyer's retention (3%; 5% for a company selling within 3 years; 7% for non-citizen sellers). RPGT has been self-assessed since 1 January 2025.
- [Malaysia Salary Calculator 2026: PCB, EPF, SOCSO & EIS](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/salary-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates 2026 Malaysian take-home pay from gross monthly salary: EPF (KWSP Third Schedule), SOCSO, EIS, LINDUNG 24 Jam (PERKESO, RM6,000 ceiling) and PCB/MTD tax (LHDN computerised method), with employer cost and a table of net pay at common salaries.
- [Semak Tracking City-Link: Status Parcel City-Link Express](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-citylink/): Semak tracking City-Link Express: membuka laman tracking rasmi City-Link untuk nombor konsainan, menerangkan format nombor, status biasa, tindakan jika penghantaran gagal, dan latar belakang City-Link Express yang ditubuhkan pada 1979 sebagai kurier milik tempatan pertama Malaysia.
- [Semak Tracking GDEX: Status Parcel GDEX Malaysia](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-gdex/): Semak tracking GDEX (GD Express): membuka laman tracking rasmi GDEX untuk nombor nota konsainan, menerangkan format nombor, status GDEX biasa, tindakan jika parcel gagal dihantar, dan latar belakang GD Express Carrier Bhd.
- [Semak Tracking J&T Express: Status Parcel J&T Malaysia](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-jnt/): Semak tracking J&T Express Malaysia: membuka laman tracking rasmi J&T Malaysia untuk nombor waybill (biasanya 12 digit), menerangkan status J&T seperti Picked Up, Arrival, Departure, On Delivery dan On Hold, kenapa ada jurang antara imbasan dan bila perlu menghubungi penjual atau J&T.
- [Semak Tracking Ninja Van: Status Parcel & Ninja Point](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-ninja-van/): Semak tracking Ninja Van Malaysia: membuka laman tracking rasmi Ninja Van untuk ID tracking (biasanya bermula NV, NVMY atau MYNJV), menerangkan status seperti Pending Pickup, Re-attempt, To Collect dan Returned to Sender, serta cara Ninja Point berfungsi.
- [Semak Tracking Parcel: Semua Kurier Malaysia (Pos Laju, J&T, SPX)](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-parcel/): Versi Bahasa Melayu: mengenal pasti kurier Malaysia daripada format nombor tracking (Pos Laju, J&T Express, SPX Express, Ninja Van, DHL, GDEX, City-Link, Flash Express, Lazada LEX, Skynet, Line Clear, Aramex, FedEx, UPS) dan membuka laman tracking rasmi kurier dengan nombor telah disalin; menerangkan format nombor tracking, maksud status tracking dan tindakan jika parcel tidak bergerak.
- [Semak Tracking Pos Laju: Status Parcel & Maksudnya](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-pos-laju/): Semak tracking Pos Laju (Pos Malaysia): membuka laman tracking rasmi Pos Malaysia untuk nombor S10 13 aksara, menerangkan format nombor, maksud huruf perkhidmatan, setiap status Pos Laju dan cara mengambil parcel di pejabat pos.
- [SSPN Calculator 2026: Savings, 4.10% Dividend and Tax Relief](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/sspn-calculator/): Projects Simpan SSPN (PTPTN's National Education Savings Scheme) savings and tax relief: the yearly dividend is credited on the average monthly balance (4.10% for 2025, the highest in 11 years; 4.05% for 2024; 3.60% for 2023), and deposits give income tax relief of up to RM8,000 a year per taxpayer until YA2027; tax saved = tax before relief − tax after relief at YA2026 resident rates. Example: RM200 a month for 18 years at 4.10% grows to about RM63,497 (RM43,200 deposited, RM20,297 dividends); RM2,400 a year of deposits saves RM264 of tax at RM60,000 chargeable income; the full RM8,000 (about RM667 a month) saves RM880 at RM60,000 and RM2,000 at RM120,000. Simpan SSPN Prime opens from RM20 with no monthly commitment; Simpan SSPN Plus starts at about RM30 a month with takaful cover.
- [TNB Bill Calculator 2026: Electricity Bill by the New Tariff](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/tnb-bill-calculator/): Calculates the TNB domestic electricity bill (Peninsular Malaysia) under the RP4 tariff from 1 July 2025: energy charge 27.03 sen/kWh (up to 1,500 kWh), capacity 4.55 sen/kWh and network 12.85 sen/kWh, less the Energy Efficiency Incentive (EEI) for use up to 1,000 kWh (the band rate × all kWh, 25 sen for 1–200 kWh down to 0.5 sen for 901–1,000 kWh); AFA (monthly fuel adjustment), the RM10 retail charge and 8% SST (on kWh above the protection level) apply only above the protection level of 600 kWh, raised to 800 kWh for September to December 2026; KWTBB 1.6% above 300 kWh. Examples: 200 kWh RM38.86, 300 kWh RM65.79, 600 kWh RM215.98.
- [Tukar Tarikh Hijrah ke Masihi: Kalendar Hijrah Malaysia 2026](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/tukar-tarikh-hijrah/): Menukar tarikh Hijrah ke Masihi dan Masihi ke Hijrah bagi tahun 1400H hingga 1500H (21 November 1979 hingga 16 November 2077) mengikut takwim rasmi Malaysia: permulaan bulan dikira dengan kriteria imkanur rukyah MABIMS yang digunakan JAKIM (mulai 1443H, ketinggian anak bulan sekurang-kurangnya 3° dan elongasi 6.4° ketika matahari terbenam), dan sepadan dengan setiap tarikh takwim rasmi yang disemak dari 1443H hingga 1449H. Memaparkan tarikh Hijrah hari ini, hari dalam minggu, bilangan hari bulan Hijrah, jadual 12 bulan dan tarikh penting (Awal Muharam, Maulidur Rasul, Israk Mikraj, Awal Ramadan, Nuzul al-Quran, Hari Raya Aidilfitri, Hari Arafah, Aidiladha). Ramadan, Syawal dan Zulhijah tetap tertakluk kepada pengumuman rukyah Penyimpan Mohor Besar Raja-Raja.
- [Unit Trust Calculator Malaysia: Returns After Sales Charge and Fees](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/unit-trust-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates unit trust returns in Malaysia: each investment buys units at NAV plus the sales charge (units = amount ÷ (NAV × (1 + charge))), the fund grows at its gross return less yearly fees (management plus trustee) charged monthly on the value, and the net yearly return is the internal rate of return of your cash flows. Example: RM10,000 plus RM300 a month for 10 years at a 7% gross return, 3% sales charge and 1.6% yearly fees grows to RM62,126 on RM46,000 invested, a 4.83% net return a year; the same plan through EPF i-Invest (0.5% sales charge cap) gives RM63,671, and with no charges or fees RM71,277, so charges and fees cost RM9,151. A 5% sales charge on RM10,000 takes RM476. EPF's Members Investment Scheme caps the sales charge at 0.5% online (i-Invest) and 3% through agents.
- [Unused CSS Remover: Remove Unused CSS Online Free](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/unused-css-remover/): Removes unused CSS in the browser. Inputs: any number of HTML pages, CSS files and JavaScript files (pasted or uploaded), page URLs (stylesheets on each page are discovered automatically, with an optional same-site crawl), and captures of live pages made with a bookmarklet, which include classes added by JavaScript. Exact mode parses each page and tests every selector with querySelector after removing state pseudo-classes such as :hover and pseudo-elements; keyword mode works like PurgeCSS, keeping a selector when all its class, id and tag names appear in the content. Also removes unused selectors from selector lists, unused @keyframes and @font-face rules and, optionally, unused CSS custom properties. Safelist by name or regular expression, with presets for JavaScript state classes, Blogger, WordPress and Bootstrap. Output is minified or formatted, per file or combined, with a report of everything removed. Code is not uploaded.
- [Water Bill Calculator Malaysia 2026: Tariff by State](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/water-bill-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates the domestic water bill (individual meter) in Malaysia by state with block tariffs: each band's rate applies only to the water in that band (0–20 m³, 20–35 m³, above 35 m³ a month), with a monthly minimum charge, and no SST on domestic water. Current rates per m³: Selangor, Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya (Air Selangor, from 1 September 2025) RM0.65 / RM1.62 / RM3.51, minimum RM6.50; Johor (Ranhill SAJ, 1 August 2025) RM1.05 / RM2.35 / RM3.50, minimum RM10.50; Penang (PBAPP, 1 July 2026) RM0.65 / RM1.30 / RM2.21, minimum RM6.50; Melaka (SAMB, 1 August 2025) RM0.94 / RM1.69 / RM2.26, minimum RM9.40; Kedah (SADA, 1 August 2025) RM0.81 / RM1.48 / RM2.00, minimum RM8.10; Kelantan (Air Kelantan, 10 September 2025) RM0.80 / RM1.55 / RM2.10, minimum RM8.00; Terengganu (SATU, 1 August 2025) RM0.66 / RM1.69 / RM2.25, minimum RM6.60. Example bills for 30 m³: Selangor RM29.20, Johor RM44.50, Penang RM26.00, Melaka RM35.70, Kedah RM31.00, Kelantan RM31.50, Terengganu RM30.10. Penang 35 m³ = RM32.50 (PBAPP's own example).
- [Working Days Calculator Malaysia 2026-2027 by State](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/working-days-calculator-malaysia/): Counts working days in Malaysia by state for 2026 and 2027: calendar days minus the state's weekend (Friday and Saturday in Kedah, Kelantan and Terengganu; Saturday and Sunday in all other states, including Johor since 1 January 2025) and federal and state public holidays that fall on workdays, including replacement holidays, then minus annual leave. Also adds N working days to a start date for deadlines. Results: Selangor has 248 working days in 2027 (244 in 2026); Kuala Lumpur 247, Johor 248, Kedah 244, Kelantan 241 and Terengganu 239 in 2027. November 2026 has 20 working days in Selangor (Deepavali on Sunday 8 November, replaced on Monday 9 November). 14 working days from 14 October 2026 in Selangor ends on 3 November 2026. Islamic holiday dates are subject to the official moon sighting.
- [Zakat Calculator Malaysia 2026: Income Zakat, Nisab, Tax Rebate](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/zakat-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates income zakat (zakat pendapatan) in Malaysia at 2.5% once yearly income reaches the nisab (the value of 85 g of gold; default RM38,748, Lembaga Zakat Selangor July–December 2026), by the gross method or the net method after LZS 2026 had kifayah (working adult RM4,944, non-working adult RM2,004, child 7–17 RM4,896, child 6 and under RM2,100, dependant in higher education RM7,356 a year) and EPF contributions; gives the yearly and monthly salary-deduction amount and the 100% income tax rebate under section 6A(3) of the Income Tax Act 1967, capped at the tax charged.

## Directory

- [Free online tools](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/): Canonical directory with tool descriptions, categories and usage guidance.

## Developer Tools

- [JavaScript Minifier & Obfuscator](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/javascript-minifier/): Minify JavaScript and configure obfuscation options to reduce file size and transform your code.
- [CSS Minifier](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/css-minifier/): Compress CSS by removing unnecessary whitespace and comments, then copy or download the result.
